title: Core Duo #08
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, bold and confident, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel — a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, cheerful, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern — sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Right woman's footwear: extreme silver platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
